{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no correction needed
data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final across ALL patients
# The question asks for the mean across ALL patients, including those with biomarker_baseline == -999
# We do NOT exclude any patient based on baseline value — only on duplication and batch correction
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Print result
mean_biomarker_final"}
